description: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited engages in the design, engineering, procurement, construction, operation, and maintenance of solar power generating system and battery energy projects in India. It operates through Engineering, procurement, and construction contracts; and Manufacturing segments. The company provides end-to-end solutions for renewable energy projects under CAPEX and RESCO models. It also offers ground mount solar EPC services, rooftop solar installation services, as well as operates as an Independent Power Producer (IPP). In addition, the company is involved in asset management and provides battery energy storage solutions. It serves public sector undertakings and commercial and industrial clients. Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Noida, India.
